test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The functions of bile juice are mentioned below. Select the option that is NOT the function of bile juice.

options.text: Increases the efficiency of the action of pancreatic enzymes
Breaks down large fat globules into smaller ones
Provides alkaline medium to the food for the action of pancreatic enzymes
Has a protein digesting enzyme that helps in the digestion of proteins

solution:
The correct answer is __Has a protein digesting enzyme that helps in the digestion of proteins__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bile juice

 
 
• ​The Latin word** "Bilis,"** which refers to a** fluid** that may be **dark green to yellowish-brown** and produced by the **liver **of most vertebrates and aids in the digestion of **lipids** in the intestine, is the origin of the word "bile."
 
• Bile is constantly secreted from the** liver** and stored and concentrated in the **gallbladder** in humans.
 
• Bile or gall is made by the liver and helps to **emulsify food lipids** by acting as a surfactant.
 
• This stored bile is released into the** duodenum** to carry out the digestion process after food is consumed.
 
• The following is the composition of hepatic bile: 97–98% **water,** 0.7 % **bile salts**, 0.2% **bilirubin**, 0.51 % **fats like cholesterol, fatty acids, and lecithin.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Liver**

 
 
• The liver can be found in the **abdomen's upper right**. It is the** largest gland** in the human body, and it is responsible for a number of essential functions. It is the only organ capable of effective **regeneration.**
 
• A larger right lobe and a smaller left lobe make up the** triangular, bilobed liver structure.** The two lobes are separated by the** falciform ligament.**
 
• The liver is covered by **Glisson's capsule**, a fibrous tissue layer. The **peritoneum** covers this capsule. The liver is shielded from physical harm by this.
 
• **Vitamin K** is absorbed by bile, and if bile isn't produced, clotting factors won't be produced either.
 
• **Kuffer cells** that are involved in **immune activity** are found in the liver. Any disease-causing agents are destroyed by these.
